sights.n: Sapporo Clock Tower (札幌市時計台)
sights.address: Kita 1-jo Nishi 2-chome, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-0001, Japan
sights.w: The 1878 wooden drill hall of the Sapporo Agricultural College, its clock still striking the hours — the city's symbol and an Important Cultural Property.

sights.n: Former Hokkaido Government Office (Akarenga, 赤れんが庁舎)
sights.address: Kita 3-jo Nishi 6-chome, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-8588, Japan
sights.w: The 1888 neo-baroque red-brick seat of the Hokkaido Development Commission — reopened 25 July 2025 after a multi-year restoration as a museum of Hokkaido history with a free garden.

sights.address: Ōdōri Nishi 1–12-chome, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-0042, Japan
sights.w: The 1.5 km green firebreak that splits Sapporo north from south — stage of the Sapporo Snow Festival in February, beer gardens and the autumn food festival.
Isamu Noguchi's last great work: a former landfill sculpted into one park-sized artwork — Mt Moere, the Glass Pyramid, the Sea Fountain.

sights.n: Historical Village of Hokkaido (北海道開拓の村)
sights.address: 50-1 Konopporo, Atsubetsu-chō, Atsubetsu-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 004-0006, Japan
sights.w: Open-air museum of 50-plus relocated Meiji–early Shōwa buildings — herring lodges, farmhouses, a horse-drawn tram — telling the story of Hokkaido's settlement.

sights.n: Sapporo Hitsujigaoka Observation Hill (さっぽろ羊ヶ丘展望台)
sights.w: The hill with the bronze of Dr William S. Clark pointing to the horizon ('Boys, be ambitious!') over sheep pasture and the Ishikari Plain.
Ropeway and mini-cable car to a 531 m summit for one of Japan's 'new three great night views' over the Sapporo grid.
Hokkaido's principal Shinto shrine in the Maruyama primeval forest, founded 1869 for the island's pioneer deities — cherry and plum blossom in spring.

sights.n: Sapporo TV Tower (さっぽろテレビ塔)
sights.address: Ōdōri Nishi 1-chome, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-0042, Japan
sights.w: The 147 m 1957 tower at the head of Ōdōri Park — the 90 m deck looks straight down the park's length.

sights.n: Sapporo Beer Museum (サッポロビール博物館)
sights.address: Kita 7-jo Higashi 9-chome 1-1, Higashi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 065-8633, Japan
sights.w: Japan's only beer museum, in the 1890 red-brick Sapporo Sugar Company building — the story of the oldest Japanese beer brand, with a tasting salon.

sights.n: Hokkaido University Botanic Garden (北海道大学植物園)
sights.address: Kita 3-jo Nishi 8-chome, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-0003, Japan
sights.w: A 13 ha 1886 garden in the middle of downtown — native Hokkaido flora, Ainu ethnographic collection and the Miyabe memorial.

sights.address: Jōzankei Onsen, Minami-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 061-2302, Japan
sights.w: Sapporo's own hot-spring town an hour south, in a Toyohira River gorge inside Shikotsu-Tōya National Park — foot baths and autumn colour.
